findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recent_signals · Private data: search_events, company_history, company_snapshot, company_by_nif, vat_check, brand_owner, company_brands, company_grants, company_contracts, recent_signals, daily_digest · Public sink: company_snapshot, vat_check, brand_owner, company_brands, company_grants, recent_signals, daily_digest, act_stats · Destructive: company_contracts, registry_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recent_signals · Private data: search_events, company_history, company_snapshot, company_by_nif, vat_check, brand_owner, company_brands, company_grants, company_contracts, recent_signals, daily_digest · Public sink: company_snapshot, vat_check, brand_owner, company_brands, company_grants, recent_signals, daily_digest, act_stats · Destructive: company_contracts, registry_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
